snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 075 - The Double Shooting - RayStorm x RayCrisis (2001)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Double Shooting: RayStorm x RayCrisis is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Taito Corporation and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2001.
